title: Registration in Hebrew
changes: The registration page — the role you are here as, the language you prefer, your relationship to the story — now reads in Hebrew under /he, along with the "Optional" and file-count notes in the sidebar.
The preferred-language choice finally does something: it starts set to the language you are already reading, and choosing the other one moves you into that language when you continue.
One word is marked for the organisation to confirm: מארח/ת, for the person who runs an evening at home.
